data.body: Implemented in worktree fix-degraded-text-2 (base origin/main c4c668544b5). New helper `_render_model_never_ran` in src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py prints `model did not run: <llm_error[:300]>` when coverage.llm_ran is False and `build drift: <remedy>` when coverage.build_drift carries a remedy; CHANGE_SETTINGS message in src/rebar/llm/failure.py reworded to name credentials, model id and bounds (classification unchanged); docs/config.md table row updated to match. Inherited RED tests failed on origin/main for the bug's reasons (3 failures) and pass now. Hand repro with a real Bedrock 400 (bogus model id) and a temp repo whose build lags config by 2 commits: before = only verdict + counts and the "exceeded a configured bound" stderr line; after = both new lines plus the corrected stderr message. make verify running.
